question: An engineer must configure a Cisco MDS 9000 Series Switch to store generated log messages to a file. The file must store logs of the severity of "warning" and above, and the file size must not exceed 20,000 bytes. Which command accomplishes this task?
theory: NX-OS syslog severities are numbered 0 (emergency, most severe) through 7 (debug, least severe), with 4 corresponding to 'warning'; the 'logging logfile <name> <severity> size <bytes>' command both names the log file and sets the minimum severity level (and maximum size) of messages stored in it, so capturing warning-and-above messages in a file capped at 20,000 bytes requires severity level 4 and 'size 20000' exactly. (Cisco NX-OS System Management Configuration Guide)
